# 2.11.0 fails to resolve forward ref (future annotation)?

### Description

With Pydantic 2.10.6, this code works fine and prints a schema:

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated, Any

from pydantic import Field, TypeAdapter
from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass


def _add_markdown_description(schema: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    schema["markdownDescription"] = schema["title"]


@dataclass
class MyModel:
    something: Annotated[
        bool | Unset,
        Field(
            description="Test.",
            field_title_generator=lambda name, _: name,
            json_schema_extra=_add_markdown_description,
        ),
    ] = True


@dataclass
class Unset:
    pass


adapter = TypeAdapter(MyModel)
print(adapter.json_schema())
```
